3.  24-54383  Recommendation to receive and file a report from the City Health Officer.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Schwerin, seconded by Member Gupta, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  10 Sanders, Schwerin, Gupta, Lesen, McNeeley, Red Eagle, Tejani,
  Walton, Clark, Van Meeveren
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 5 St Bernard, Betancourt, Curtis, Girgis, Vaias

  Board member Red Eagle asked about the status of the TB Outbreak emergency
  declaration and inquired as to whether the cases were rising or remaining stable.

  Dr. Tejani inquired about the status of the 85 individuals identified as having either
  refused or been unable to locate.

  Board member McNeeley inquired about the risk factors based on this outbreak
  occurring through the presence of TB and contacts at a local hotel, and asked what
  the implications might be for future outbreaks. He asked if this outbreak altered our
  protocols for future communicable disease control.

4.  24-54384  Recommendation to receive and file an update on the City’s legislative agenda.

  A motion was made by Member Walton, seconded by Member McNeeley, to
  approve recommendation. The motion by the following vote:

  Yes:  10 Sanders, Schwerin, Gupta, Lesen, McNeeley, Red Eagle, Tejani,
  Walton, Clark, Van Meeveren
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 5 St Bernard, Betancourt, Curtis, Girgis, Vaias

  Andrea Lee, Legisilative and Partnerships Manager, briefly spoke on the following;
  • Provided an update on the State Budget, FY 24/25 Future of Public Health
  funding.
  • Update on the Labor, Health and Human Services and Education Senate

5.  24-54385  Recommendation to review and approve the 2023 Board of Health Annual Report.

  A motion was made by Member Lesen, seconded by Member McNeeley, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  10 Sanders, Schwerin, Gupta, Lesen, McNeeley, Red Eagle, Tejani,

  The Board reviewed and approved the 2023/24 Board of Health and Human

6.  24-54387  Recommendation to submit a letter to the Mayor and City Council proposing that
  the City install beach water hazard signage along City waterways.

  This agenda item was laid over by consensus to the next Board of Health and
  Human Services meeting.

7.  24-54388  Recommendation to discuss Board Goals and Infrastructure.

  A motion was made by Member Lesen, seconded by Member Tejani, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  10 Sanders, Schwerin, Gupta, Lesen, McNeeley, Red Eagle, Tejani,
  Walton, Clark, Van Meeveren
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 5 St Bernard, Betancourt, Curtis, Girgis, Vaias

  The Board discussed;
  • Reaching out to James Suazo to obtain his final report and
  recommendations from the moderator-led strategic planning meetings.
  • A brief discussion ensued regarding the number of required trainings being
  asked of the Board, and the need to ensure that all trainings are completed
  in a timely manner.
  • Current vacancies on the Board. Chair Sanders requested that the Board
  reach out to their contacts regarding any interest in serving on the Board.
  Current vacancies include;
